module.purpose: Defines a React email template for delivering a localized email-verification code with application branding and support contact information.
module.summary: This module renders a branded verification message from localized content, recipient data, and a one-time verification code. It composes the shared email shell with structured paragraphs, inline styling, a conditional subject suffix for verification state, and a mailto link for the support team.
module.businessContext: Supports account and email ownership verification in the scheduling product. If rendering fails, users may be unable to complete verification or receive support guidance.
functions: VerifyEmailByCode (~L6-53): Renders localized verification-code email content with branding and support contact.

detail.name: VerifyEmailByCode
detail.signature: export const VerifyEmailByCode = (props: EmailVerifyCode & Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseEmailHtml>>) =>
preconditions: props provides the fields required by EmailVerifyCode, including language, user.name, verificationEmailCode, and isVerifyingEmail.
props.language accepts the referenced translation keys and interpolation values.
postconditions: Returns a BaseEmailHtml email containing the localized verification header, user greeting, verification code, scheduling sign-off, and support mail link.
Uses the verifying-email subject suffix only when props.isVerifyingEmail is truthy.
invariants: The verificationEmailCode is rendered as the email body code.
The support link uses a mailto URL based on SUPPORT_MAIL_ADDRESS and opens in a new browser context with noreferrer.
APP_NAME is supplied as appName to the localized subject and props.user.name is supplied as name to the greeting.
SENDER_NAME is supplied as companyName to the localized team signature.
edgeCases: When props.isVerifyingEmail is truthy, the subject translation key is verify_email_subject_verifying_email.
When props.isVerifyingEmail is falsy, the subject translation key is verify_email_subject.
An empty or otherwise supplied verificationEmailCode is rendered directly without validation or transformation.
The function does not define local handling for missing required props or translation failures; such failures propagate from property access or props.language.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; errors from invalid props or the language function propagate.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns JSX for BaseEmailHtml with a localized subject and four content sections: heading, greeting, verification-code body, and scheduling/support signature. The support anchor href is mailto:${SUPPORT_MAIL_ADDRESS}.
detail.summary: Renders an email verification message containing a localized subject, greeting, verification code, and support contact. The subject varies according to whether the email is being verified.
